description: Parameterised stage blocks for the stage-full track tier: reading-window text slots, prop stand-up on the rig hinge, paper-framed B-roll inset, fold-and-rebuild relocation, exploded layer stack, and the rotating picture-disc scenery change; plus focus-light sweep and split, tray sorting with causal leaders, and text written on a paper sign; plus prop.states, a data-described multi-part prop with named states for each Work's own objects.
